# PattN 7.25.2-P1

This is the first integrated PattN Discovery + Reviver release based on v2rayN 7.25.2.

## Highlights

- Bundled `pattn-discovery` engine for bounded DNS/DNSSEC tracing, resolver evidence, endpoint probing, and deterministic protocol framing.
- Reviver repair pipeline with immutable source snapshots, bounded mutations, repeated real-core validation, safe promotion/rollback, conflict-aware experiment ordering, and human-confirmed outcomes.
- Proxy test/history intelligence, endpoint lifecycle history, subscription fleet-health summaries, retention/compaction controls, and privacy-preserving learning primitives.
- Signed provider/ASN catalog lifecycle with monotonic revisions, expiry, transport/signature evidence, rollback protection, and durable persistence.
- Evidence-gated upload-stall probing and optional operator-supplied Xray finalMask experiments; PattN does not infer carrier/DPI/censorship from a timeout alone.
- WPF and Avalonia Discovery/Reviver management UI, accessibility metadata, bounded settings, and expanded English/Persian localization.

## Release security

- Third-party runtime assets and toolchains are version/digest locked; mutable release inputs are rejected by CI.
- ZIP payloads are deterministic; DEB/RPM payloads normalize source timestamps/metadata and are checked by reproducibility gates.
- Release assets include SHA-256 inventories, SPDX inventories, dependency SBOMs, SLSA-style provenance metadata, and GitHub OIDC-backed build attestations.
- GPG detached signatures are published additionally when the optional repository signing key is configured.
- macOS DMG releases are code-signed/notarized when the Apple release credentials are configured; unsigned/notarized containers are never substituted silently.

## Runtime update safety

PattN's legacy in-app application/core/geo updater is intentionally **fail-closed** in this release. A digest fetched from the same release origin is not an independent trust root. Runtime network updates remain disabled until a client-pinned verification key and signed-manifest/rotation design are deliberately shipped. Subscription refresh and ordinary proxy/network features are unaffected.

## DNS root rollover

The embedded DNS root trust-anchor set contains both KSK-2017 and KSK-2024 with pre/post-rollover tests. The authenticated live IANA review remains intentionally date-gated for the scheduled 2026-10-11 rollover and will not be marked complete before post-event evidence exists.
